additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478455-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002555] Logs Check CRM:00263000455
additional_info.body:
Dear Manuela,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0478455.
I analyzed the logs which are between 09:17 and 09:33 CU time, and these are my findings:
At 2026-02-13T09:17:03, the customer authenticated via app outlet 2, but connected DC2, which is configured as outlet 1.
The authentication phase failed at 2026-02-13T09:18:15.
The vehicle was left plugged in, and the charger attempted another authentication at 2026-02-13T09:18:39, but no new remote authorization was sent, hence it failed again for the same reason at 2026-02-13T09:23:39.
At 2026-02-13T09:24:52 the EV was disconencted.
At 2026-02-13T09:33:30 a different IdTag authorized via app for outlet 1 and correctly connected DC2.
The charging session started correctly.
In conclusion, the reason of failed charging session was incorrect authorization process from client.
Since there is no issue on the charger and the outcome of the analysis has been provided, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
